Create the API key in the MySkoda app: Profile -> Smart Home -> Create Key -> enter any name -> copy VIN and API token into this module.

actions.caption: Test connection
actions.onClick: echo MSKODA_TestConnection($id) ? 'Connection successful - vehicle data received.' : 'Connection failed - check instance status and API data.';

actions.caption: Test notification
actions.onClick: echo MSKODA_TestNotification($id) ? 'Notification sent.' : 'Notification could not be sent. Check the visualization instance ID.';

actions.onClick: echo MSKODA_RefreshApiDefinition($id) ? 'API definition updated' : 'API definition could not be loaded';
